## Gramstax.hookErrorPage() method

Hook called when a page handler throws an error.

**Signature:**

```typescript
/** @virtual */
hookErrorPage(ctx: ICtx, listenerName: string, error: any, isEdit: boolean): Promise<void>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

## Remarks

Override this method to handle errors gracefully, e.g., sending an error message to the user or logging to an external service.

## Example


```typescript
async hookErrorPage(ctx: Ctx, listenerName: string, error: any) {
  await ctx.reply(undefined, {error: "An error occurred"})
  console.error(error)
}
```
